name: minecraft-skin-maker
description: Turn images or text into Minecraft skins with editable designs, rendered previews and Bedrock packs.

interface.shortDescription: Turn an image or description into a Minecraft skin.
interface.longDescription: Attach a character image, describe an idea, or revise an existing skin. Minecraft Skin Maker creates a 64×64 skin PNG, an editable design, previews rendered from the exported texture, and a Bedrock skin pack. It handles technical choices automatically and compares the output with your reference. Requires an agent with image inspection, file access and Python execution. Java and Windows/mobile Bedrock import instructions are included.
defaultPrompt: Turn this character image into a Minecraft skin.
Make a Minecraft skin of a forest explorer with a red scarf.
Change this skin’s hoodie to green and keep its other details.
